has_own_site_evidence: No website field on the Google Business Profile. WebSearch for the business name turned up only third-party directories (Great Guys Moving, MoveBuddha, Thumbtack-adjacent listings). A guessed domain wilfredosmoving.com resolves but is a parked/placeholder domain unrelated to the business. The only 'website' link surfaced in the Great Guys Moving directory listing (headlinelogic.com) was checked directly and is an unrelated third-party news portal, not owned by the business. No Facebook or Instagram profile found for the business via WebSearch.
email_search_evidence: WebSearch for business name + contact/email: no email found. Checked Great Guys Moving and MoveBuddha directory listings (no email, no mailto links). No Facebook/Instagram page found to check an About section. No linktree/booking page exists (moving company, no online booking platform). Conclusion: no public email found, outreach registered as pending_manual.
